description: Implementation of DefaultTbClusterService managing message dispatching, notifications, and cluster events within Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DefaultTbClusterService
classes.description: Service managing message dispatching, notifications, and cluster events within Thingsboard.

methods.name: pushMsgToCore
methods.description: Send message to core service, either by tenant and entity or directly via TopicPartitionInfo.

methods.name: pushMsgToEdge
methods.description: Send message to edge service for specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcast a component lifecycle event to relevant services.

methods.name: broadcastEntityChangeToTransport
methods.description: Notify transport layer of entity change.

methods.name: broadcastEntityDeleteToTransport
methods.description: Notify transport layer of entity deletion.

methods.name: broadcastEntityStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Notify services of entity state change.

methods.name: sendDeviceStateServiceEvent
methods.description: Send device state change event to core.

methods.name: pushMsgToCalculatedFields
methods.description: Send calculated fields message.

methods.name: pushMsgToVersionControl
methods.description: Send message to version control service.

methods.name: pushNotificationToCore
methods.description: Send notification message to core service.

methods.name: pushNotificationToRuleEngine
methods.description: Send notification message to rule engine.

methods.name: pushNotificationToTransport
methods.description: Send notification message to transport layer.

methods.name: pushMsgToEdgeNotification
methods.description: Send notification message to edge.

methods.name: pushEdgeSyncRequestToEdge
methods.description: Send edge sync request.

methods.name: pushEdgeSyncResponseToCore

methods.name: onDeviceUpdated

methods.name: onAssetUpdated

methods.name: onCalculatedFieldUpdated
methods.description: Handle calculated field update events.

methods.description: Handle relation update events.
